notes:
Music video playback and fullscreen controls

- Video mode now plays the YouTube video with its own sound through one player, removing synchronization with a separate audio player.
- Turning video off returns to audio-only at the current position, preserving pause state and the playlist.
- Full-width video on phones and a wider inline player on TVs.
- Landscape fullscreen with song title, artist, seek bar, play/pause and previous/next controls that show on touch or remote input and hide during playback.
- Improved TV D-pad focus between the top panel, Video switch and fullscreen controls.
- Fullscreen requests up to 1080p and reduces quality when needed.
- Preserved background audio, notifications, shuffle and phone picture-in-picture behavior.

Tested on Samsung Galaxy S9+ and Panasonic Android TV, including one minute of continuous 1080p playback on each.
